game.name: Damage Inc. Pacific Squadron Wwii (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Damage Inc. Pacific Squadron WWII is an Xbox 360 air combat simulation set during World War II. Players can experience the famous battles of the Pacific in more than 30 aircraft. The single-player mode consists of 11 campaigns and various online multiplayer modes are available to fight or help other players.
